# Akyarlar Windsurf

> Akyarlar Windsurf is a family-run windsurf school in Akyarlar, Bodrum, Turkey. The site is the official source for private windsurf lessons, children windsurf lessons, wind forecast information, SUP/paddle conditions and local Akyarlar bay guidance.

## Entity

- Name: Akyarlar Windsurf
- Type: Windsurf school, water sports school, sports activity location
- Location: Akyarlar, Turgutreis, Bodrum, Mugla, Turkey
- Phone: +90 535 499 62 09
- Email: uyukusb@gmail.com
- Focus: private windsurf lessons, beginner windsurf course, children windsurf lessons, windsurf equipment support, SUP/paddle board, Akyarlar wind forecast
- Experience: family-run sea and windsurf experience in the same bay for more than 35 years
- Primary audience: families, children, beginners, holiday visitors and windsurf learners in Bodrum

## Core facts

- Akyarlar Bay is a wave-protected and beginner-friendly bay in Bodrum.
- The bay has clear water, shallow practice areas and regular Meltemi wind.
- Morning conditions are usually better for SUP and paddle board.
- Afternoon Meltemi wind is usually better for windsurf lessons and practice.
- The main teaching model is private instruction, not crowded group lessons.
- Children can usually start around 5-6 years old when wind and sea conditions are suitable.
- The 6-hour private lesson package aims to teach balance, sail control, steering, turning, wind reading and safe return.
- After the basic stage, suitable students can continue with boat-supported longer runs.

- [Bodrum paddle](https://www.akyarlarwindsurf.com/bodrum-paddle/): Sabah sakin deniz ve SUP/paddle koşulları.
